items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: Well, I played with Tigg Chambers.

ctx.x: Any other bands in New Orleans that you played with that you can remember?
Well, I played with Tigg Chambers. Who else? Who else was Tigg Chambers? You know. Who else was in Tigg Chambers band? How did they spell that name? Is it Tick or Tigg?
